Retained heap command:
go test -run '^$' -bench '^BenchmarkRetainedAST$' -benchmem -benchtime=5x -count=3 .

Median retained results:
BenchmarkRetainedAST/Medium-18               34651 retained-B/doc
BenchmarkRetainedAST/Huge_1MB-18          48694248 retained-B/doc
BenchmarkRetainedAST/Attributes_100KB-18   2620704 retained-B/doc

Shallow universal node size:
BenchmarkNodeSize-18                           264 shallow-B/node

Largest Huge_1MB node populations:
Text 67890; Strong 15768; Paragraph 11826; TableCell 7884; ListItem 6570;
Link 5256. These six kinds account for about 84% of the 137095 nodes.

Retained heap is measured after a full GC with the input string already live.
It is noisier than ordinary benchmark allocation data and should be compared
across several runs on an otherwise idle machine.
